notes.title: Pixel Gods
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow Xon,

It's been a while, but today we are happy to release the latest incarnation of Xon.
There has been almost too many changes to list, as the game has changed a lot.

The major focus has been on making the game more streamlined, while also making it less repetitive. 

Powers are no longer picked, interrupting gameplay, but are instead unlocked by completing special land quests, this should make for a more smooth experience and allow for more planning, regarding witch powers the player would like to have, instead of it just being random.

Border Statues now allow migration to neighboring lands without building a Gate, this speeds up early expansion opportunities while still allowing for rush tactics in PvP (and actually making them stronger, since players will now have more lands.)

Resources have been heavily reduced, this also encourages expansion and reduces Shrine spam, since resource harvesting is now much more important.

AI art is gone! It was really fun making AI art with my kid, but in the game, it clashed heavily with the very simply art style and also there was a whole slew of ethics and moral issues with AI art that I had not really not given too much thought. Instead we now more animated gods, we hope you will love it as much as we do!

[b]Changes, in no specific order[/b]
[list]
[*] Witches have had their target count reduced (again! oink oink)
[*] Minor miracle revamp, all minor miracles are now simpler and the effect is instant.
[*] AI Attack targeting has been revamped, they will now prefer closer targets.
[*] AI Gathering, will now try to spread out more to avoid wasting time.
[*] Coin can no longer build merchants but  can turn followers into gold coins.
[*] God selection is now mandatory in all game modes.
[*] Starting powers are now listed on god selection.
[*] All summons have had their cooldowns adjusted slightly.
[*] Soldiers and Archers are now auto produced (cost food).
[*] Housing is now land specific.
[*] Resources are now listed to make land types more easy to understand.
[*] Border Statues now allow invading adjacent lands.
[*] Land quests must be completed to gain new powers.
[*] Riders have been removed and are now a Leaf/Plains soldier upgrade.
[*] Tutorial has been rewritten to reflect the game changes.
[*] Alternative game modes have been disabled (for now)
[*] Leaf/Forest now have Treants, baseline.
[*] Coin/Swamp now have Sunken Treasures, baseline.
[*] Skull/Swamp now have Swamp Things, baseline.
[*] Fixed an issue where passive essence gain was now being applied.
[*] Essence bar now displays tick timer.
[*] Higher difficulties will now make neutrals much more aggressive.
[*] Smite base damage has been increased.
[*] All base building prices have been reduced by 75%.
[*] A rare crash bug has been fixed (Sending Vessels while mouse is outside window)
[*] Fixed a bug where allied units in coop would become hostile.
[*] Fixed a bug where villagers would walk back after being sent by a vessel.
[*] Resource loading is now async and much faster.
[*] Resources loading screen (temporary)
[*] ISSUE: Some progression play perks may have been bugged by minor power changes.
[/list]

notes.title: Ascension
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow Xon,

Today I am finally able to announce that I have completed the first five levels of progression play. By conquering difficulty levels, you can now gain points to be spent on perks, unlocking new play styles. You can also customize your god before the game starts, giving you agency over your progression path.

Each aspect currently has five tiers of perks, with three perks for each tier, with more coming in the future.

[h2]The perk lines are as follows[/h2]
[h3]Coin[/h3]
Greed: Money for power, grants more soldiers and the ability to smite with gold.
Luck: Empowers random mechanics and introduces new ones.
Gold: Accelerates economy production and traders.
[h3]Ember[/h3]
Flame: Smite becomes stronger and cheaper when followers burn to death.
Smoke: Improved industry and a stronger start.
Smolder: Make everything catch fire and gain essence by doin so.
[h3]Leaf[/h3]
Thorns: Every tree an ally, powerful magic creatures.
Glade: Gain point from having unsettled lands.
Verdancy: Food and population abundance.
[h3]Moon[/h3]
Madness: Convert enemies by smiting them and harvest their dreams.
Secrets: Ascension and meditation, followers grants points when ascended.
Dreams: Through sleep everything is gained.
[h3]Skull[/h3]
Bone: Hordes of undead at your beck and call.
Blood: Bleed your followers for profit and power.
Whispers: Human souls are a great resource, and you are all about harvesting.
 

I have also included co-op play and restricted standard play, making the leaderboard much easier to read since everyone on it has been playing by the same rules.

As always, there are a bunch of bug fixes and interface optimizations as well.

[list]
[*] Dreamberries, replaces the Bountiful Growth lesser miracle
[*] Treants, magic creatures summoned by Leaf
[*] Accusers, priest variant that burns followers, Ember
[*] Bog Lords have faster attacks (50%)
[*] Ember smoldering is slightly more dangerous
[*] Calamity activation timers
[*] Army of the Dead has one extra skeleton and one fewer zombie
[*] Traders work slightly faster (10%)
[*] The witch has a slightly longer cooldown on her "Pigs!" ability
[*] Difficulty scales all calamities
[*] Perks! Can be found on the new Deity set up screen
[/list]

notes.title: Lesser Miracles
notes.notes:
Dear Fellow Xon,

I've been working on ways to make events less intrusive and upgrading altars more interesting, and I'm excited about the results!

Gaining cards after acquiring primary and secondary essence now comes through clickable bells, so you can choose cards at your leisure. Any upgrade to an altar now unlocks a lesser miracle – a single-use miracle granting you a small boon. These lesser miracles are accessed similarly to summons.

Here are a few examples of lesser miracles:

[b]The Great Motivator[/b] (Coin)
 Instantly complete all construction in one land.

[b]Lord of the Land[/b] (Leaf)
 Summon a Swamp Lord in any land (sunless).

[b]Burning Gate [/b] (Ember)
 Summon a temporary gate.

[b]Song of Lethe [/b] (Moon)
 Make up to ten creatures fall asleep and dream.

[b]Secret Cult [/b] (Skull)
 Spawn three followers in any land (sunless).

(Sunless miracles are useable in lands where the sun has yet to be lit.)

As you can see, these powerful effects accelerate the pace of the game. Since simply building an altar grants you a lesser miracle to choose from, you'll receive one right from the start.

I've also updated some of the user interface and redesigned a few buttons. Bloom has been added – I really like it, but I understand it might not be for everyone, so it's a toggle option in the menu.

There are twenty different lesser miracles for you to explore. Enjoy!

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Golden Deer would cost essence.
[*] Fixed a bug where the light would fall off the moon.
[*] Souls now grant +1 essence when harvested.
[*] Knockback effects have been toned down and no longer stack.
[*] Witches are still horrifying! bribe them instead, if you find fighting them is too difficult.
[*] Burning should no longer spread between lands.
[*] Added animated cards pictures.
[*] Particles have been updated in various places.
[*] Dreaming secondary frequency toned down by 7%.
[/list]

notes.title: Yaga's Cauldron
notes.notes:
Greetings, fellow Xon! I hope this message finds you well.

I've been closely examining matches and brewing, and I was still not entirely satisfied with the implementation of magic creatures and priests. The primary focus of this patch has been to enhance strategic interactions and refine some of the weaker powers. Some powers continue to fall short in terms of engagement, I'm considering converting a greater number of them into passive abilities instead of active ones.

I've also introduced a variety of new hostile NPCs, as I was feeling a bit repetitive with wolves and shades. All NPCs can now be bribed, enabling more peaceful expansion opportunities.

[b]New features[/b]
[list]
[*] You will now maintain your game Id if you rejoin a game.
[*] Upgrade miracles, a new type of passive miracle that changes a unit (i.e. all priests)
[*] Sunless miracles, a new tag, indicating that the miracles does not need a lit sun to cast.
[*] Bribes, NPCs can now be bribed, this has different outcomes depending on the NPC type.
[*] Streamer friendly, most game keys are now hidden (except join game)
[*] New NPC, the Yaga and her cat, she will turn attacking humans into pigs.
[*] New NPC, the Raiders, slightly stronger than wolves.
[/list]

[b]Changes, in no particular order...[/b]
[list]
[*] Priests now build passively with one spawned for each temple.
[*] Tranquility has been reworked. It now heals and cleanses hostile effects.
[*] Convert merchant is now free.
[*] Rekindle Sun has upgraded visual effect.
[*] All priest upgrades are now passive.
[*] Leaf of the Fields base power is now Cornucopia, a miracle that creates food.
[*] Love the Flame cost reduced to 1.
[*] Resource Bowl order is now fixed, preventing weird layouts in rare cases.
[*] Game Mode is now saved in settings.
[*] Better support for lower resolutions.
[*] Pox can no longer infect magic creatures and is now a miracle. (Skull of the Swamp)
[*] Resources can be focused in unlit lands.
[*] Dream passive chance reduce from 10% to 6%.
[*] Gates build 20% faster.
[*] All followers will now hunt.
[*] Fewer trees in forest lands (50%)
[*] All summoning miracle timers have been rebalanced.
[*] All miracle cooldowns are reset on game / world restart.
[*] Build orders sorted by resource required.
[/list]

notes.title: Miraculous Tidings
notes.notes:
Greetings, fellow Xon! I hope you're doing well.

We've been experimenting with new ways to handle summons, and we've finally settled on an approach that makes sense. Summons are no longer reliant on the interaction between essence and resources; instead, they operate on separate cooldowns. These cooldowns can be used on open gates or lands under your control to summon creatures. Additionally, we've introduced Miracles—a temporary type of summon that can only be attacked by Priests or by using Smite.

[list]
[*] Reduced general melee knockback and removed additive knockback
[*] Enemy vessels will not target lands where the altar has been destroyed
[*] Steam Id is now tracked, allowing you to see all games played by a specific player
[*] Love The Flame, cost reduction 5 -> 3
[*] All summons are now cooldown based and no longer requires a resource
[*] Summons now have their own buttons
[*] You can now summon directly into an open gate
[*] Miracles are a new kind of entities that has a continuous effect and can only bee attacked by priests or attacked using Smite
[*] Howling Spirits is now a miracle
[*] Slithering Death is now the default Desert/Leaf Miracle, instead of Oasis
[*] Tranquility (Leaf) is a miracle that restores food and trees
[*] Tranquility is now the default the default Plains/Leaf Miracle, instead of Maypole
[*] Conflagration (Ember) is a miracle that sets everything on fire
[*] Deep Quiet (Moon) is a miracle that forces all creature to sleep and dream
[*] Fountain of Kings (coin) is a miracle that spawns fool's gold 
[/list]

notes.title: Post championship patch
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow Xon, I hope you are doing well!
Last week the first Xon champion was crowned, trophy and all. I got quite a lot of feedback during the event and I have managed to implement some of it, please enjoy!

Post championship patch features
[list]
[*] Pasting a game code now instantly joins that game.
[*] Games will no longer be flagged as inactive if left on pause.
[*] A ring will now indicate when a resource i being dropped on a building.
[*] All building sites have had their radius increased by roughly 30%
[*] Fewer miracles are unlocked in Tutorial mode.
[*] First steps towards Steam integration, I also added a single achievement.
[*] Houses convert food into followers faster.
[*] Top five players are now targetable instead of top six.
[*] Tips and tricks are shown in the menu.
[*] F1 now shows all current miracle cards.
[*] Leaf gods now has growing seeds instead of instantaneous trees and bushes.
[*] Skull gods now release souls from slain humanoids instead of gaining energy automatically.
[*] Moon blooded soldiers no longer resurrect themselves.
[/list]

I am aware that priests and summons are a bit underused, I am considering revamping summons to be automatic, maybe spawned by temples or just instantly, when picked. I feel like the base mechanics gives you so many things to do as it is and spending essence on summons seems to interrupt the current game flow.

notes.title: Burning Ember 1.2
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow Xon,

We have been inspired by the hot weather and have come up with a new Aspect: The Burning Ember.

[b]The Burning Ember.[/b]

Ember is the fifth aspect, bringing a more aggressive playstyle to the table. With the ability to burn instead of harvesting, they are faster but more wasteful than other aspects. Many of their powers are very strong but carry inherent risks.

The starting miracles of The Ember are:
[list]
[*] Desert: Wish-granting Ifrit.
[*] Mountains: Tough, burning, Cherufe.
[*] Swamp: Sculptors Hut, capable of turning follower souls into Claymen, eternal workers.
[*] Forest: Eternal Pyre, which burns wood to generate essence.
[*] Plains: Smokestack, a building that produces gold and sparks from wood.
[*] Priest: Brahmin, can mark houses with The Burning Mark causing them to produce new followers faster.
[/list]

We have also been looking into some other features of the game. With The Ember, a bunch of other features, fixes, and balance changes will be introduced.

[b]Feature: Game Modes[/b]

All games will no longer be played in tutorial mode. Four new game modes are now available:
[list]
[*] Standard: A no-frills standard timed game.
[*] Domination: Only affiliated lands give points, and the game ends immediately if a player reaches 12 lands.
[*] Worship: Only followers give points.
[*] Freeplay: Unlimited essence and no calamities. Great for experimenting.
[/list]

[b]Features, Fixes and Changes[/b]

We have made several adjustments and additions to the game alongside The Ember aspect:

[list]
[*] AI has now been completely removed as it was never intended to be a feature and would have required too much work to become adequate.
[*] Fixed some of the issues with the new pause system.
[*] Gate Watcher (or Laser Giant, as Wilbur calls it): A new unit for Moon of the plains.
[*] Secondary aspect now only provides a passive effect.
[*] Follower/aspect miracles have been moved to the primary aspect.
[*] Leaf Secondary has been changed. This was boring - Leaf now spontaneously manifests trees and bushes in all lands.
[*] Brighter suns to prevent discoloration of certain actors.
[*] Essence now spawns in the center of its land.
[*] Follower bowl now shows the correct follower aspect.
[*] Added a borderless full-screen button.
[*] Buttons now react on mouse up instead of down to prevent accidental card picks.
[*] Essence gain per 10 seconds is now shown on the essence bar.
[*] Shrines now cost 1 stone and 3 gold.
[*] Manifesting anything now costs 15 essence, up from 5 essence.
[*] Swamp passive has changed and now generates Sparks, which can be claimed to gain 3 essence.
[*] Pox no longer works on magical creatures.
[*] Dreams and Sparks are auto clicked by hovering mouse over them.
[*] Priests have lower threat rating and soldiers have higher threat rating.
[*] Priest damage bonus versus magical creatures has been further increased.
[*] Priest upgrade miracles are now prioritized when gaining new miracles.
[*] Skull priest, Bokor, Turns dead followers into zombies.
[*] Coin priest, Hand of Midas, turns the blood of hostile creatures into gold.
[*] Temples are now built with Tree, Stone, Gold, Gold.
[*] Gilding Stone can now be destroyed manually.
[*] Most miracle effect descriptions are now shown in the tool tip.
[*] Blessing of the Leaf can now target soldiers as well.
[*] Base Essence regen increased from 1 to 3 per 10 seconds.
[*] Sending a Vessel now has a flat cost of 10 Essence.
[*] Golden Calf cost has been reduced from 25 essence to 15 essence.
[*] Awaken Land cost has been reduced from 70 essence to 30 essence.
[*] Bog Lord cost has been reduced from 30 essence to 15 essence.
[*] Moon Blood cost has been reduced from 15 essence to 1 essence.
[*] Golden Legion cost has been reduced from 5 essence to 1 essence.
[*] Dream Lord cost has been reduced from 10 essence to 5 essence.
[*] Druid cost has been reduced from 15 essence to 5 essence.
[*] Zombies last slightly longer (120 seconds up from 100 seconds).
[*] Lantern spirit sleep rate reduced.
[*] Oasis no longer spends precious essence.
[*] Faster graveyards for the Skull aspect.
[/list]

notes.title: The hills are alive
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow Xon,

Here is a small update, summer is hot and I have been outside with the kiddo, so progress has been suffering a bit, sorry.

I was not really happy with how the different terrain types distinguished themselves from each other, so we added horizon backgrounds, its very simple, but does a lot to make each terrain feel more distinct.

Also! I added Pause / Unpause functionality, when playing solo this will happen automatically when in menus or when picking a power. The implementation is a bit hacky, since it wasn't a part of the core concept and therefore not part of the architecture, so please report any weird bugs that might result from the implementation.

We also added a vessel for the Moon aspect, Wilbur was giving me a lot of grief over this one and it missing was honestly just an oversight on my part. It came out rather well I think - so for all you Dreaming Moons out there, this one is for you.

Have fun and be excellent!
 - Anton

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow Xon,

After some deliberation I have decided to make some changes to the scoring mechanics, the secondary passive point generation was simply too strong and ended by creating a gameplay loop that encouraged very simple and repetitive behavior.
Xon is meant to be, primarily, an engine building game and as such this behavior went against the core concept of the game.

With the new changes, expansion is now a lot more important and converting land is a big part of your final score.

Patch 1.1 has the following major changes:
[list]
[*] Population points have been reduced to 5 pr. populous
[*] Shrines now give 50 points each, on top of their point generation
[*] Secondary Aspect passives have been moved to Primary Aspects and point generation has been reduced
[*] Secondary Aspects have new passives
[*] Sacrificing resources has been removed
[*] Altars offers 5 passive housing
[/list]

New secondary passives:
[list]
[*] Moon: Dreaming, Followers will randomly dream
[*] Leaf: Verdant, Always spawn a tree when manifesting
[*] Coin: Golden, Followers find coins when harvesting
[*] Skull: Whispering, Gain 5 essence when a follower dies
[/list]

Other changes and fixes:
[list]
[*] Pox is now more visible
[*] Poison ticks much slower, down from once per 2 seconds to 3 seconds
[*] Priests now ignore non magical enemies
[*] Shade Statues are now considered magical
[*] Shades are stronger, fewer and have physical resistance
[*] Transforming the land has a clear visual effect (also, it is now more important part of point generation)
[*] Followers can now turn in resources at unfinished altars
[*] Hovering the scoreboard will show a score breakdown on both pages
[*] Zombies are now spawned at a Whisper Stone
[*] Whisper Stone, Monument of Tragedies and Maypole are now Shrine upgrades
[*] Clickable resources have a glitter effect
[*] Some quests have been revised
[*] Start timer is now 5 seconds instead of 10
[*] Converting creatures now maintains what they are currently carrying
[*] Wolves are slightly less aggressive
[/list]
